newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong, Hutchison reshuffle group.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong, Hutchison reshuffle group.

text.p: The Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd group, including Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd, Hutchison Whampoa Ltd and Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd, on Monday announced a major corporate reshuffle.
The reorganisation includes a general offer for Hongkong Electric at HK$26.50 per share.
Trading in Cheung Kong, CKI Holdings, Hutchison and Hongkong Electric shares were suspended on Monday morning at the companies' request, the stock exchange also said.

Hutchison said in a statement a wholly-owned unit agreed to buy for cash 7.75 million shares or 0.38 percent in Hongkong Electric at HK$26.50, representing a premium of about 4.95 percent to the shares' closing price on Friday.

The purchase would lift Hutchison's interest in Hongkong Electric to about 35.01 percent, above the exchange's takeover threshold, and Hutchison said it would make a conditional cash offer for all Hongkong Electric shares at HK$26.50 a share.
The 7.75 million shares would be purchased from parties independent of Hutchison, the company said.

But Hutchison would then transfer its stake in Hongkong Electric of 707.30 million shares to CKI Holdings for HK$18.74 billion to be satisfied by 886.21 million new CKI shares at HK$21.15 per share, the Cheung Kong group companies said in the same statement.

Cheung Kong would also transfer its existing shareholding in CKI Holdings of about 70.66 percent of the company's issued share capital to the Hutchison group for about HK$20.45 billion, the companies said.

The consideration would be satisfied by issue of 349.50 million new Hutchison shares, but in event that a waiver, to be set out in a forthcoming announcement, was not obtained, Cheung Kong would receive a consideration comprising 254.32 million new Hutchison shares and about HK$5.57 billion in cash, they said.
The price calculations of the transaction was based on Friday's closing share prices of CKI Holdings at HK$21.15 each and of Hutchison at HK$58.50 each, they added.
The group said further details, including terms and conditions, of the offer and the transactions would be announced as soon as possible. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
